_comment: Master interior scenes. Coordinates are pixels in the file under mockups/scenes/; sizes are centimetres on the wall plane. See mockups/README.md to calibrate a new one.

scenes.name: Scandinavian living room
scenes._calibration: Measured: the sideboard is 839 px wide and 462 px in the case. At a standard 120 x 65 cm that gives 6.99 and 7.11 px/cm, so the wall plane is 7.0 px/cm. Skirting edge at y=1703 puts the floor line at y=1780, just below the frame.

placements._note: Centred on the sideboard, 150 cm off the floor. The plants on top reach 104 cm, so nothing may hang lower than that.
The open wall right of the sideboard, above the armchair. Armchair tops out at 76 cm; the window frame limits width.

scenes.name: Plant wall living room
scenes._calibration: Scale set from the tall cylindrical planters: 35 cm diameter, 60 cm high, both giving ~6.2 px/cm. Floor line at y=1790. Usable wall stops short of the large plant on the right, which stands in front of the wall.

placements._note: The plants stand in front of this wall and reach 95 cm, so a work hung centre-150 cm may be no more than 100 cm tall. The large plant on the right caps the width.
Taller works hang with their centre at 170 cm, keeping the bottom edge clear of the planting.

scenes.name: White brick loft
scenes._calibration: Scale from the brick coursing: a Fourier read of the mortar lines gives a 28.6 px period, which at a standard 86 mm course is 3.32 px/cm. Cross-checks against the armchair at 101 cm wide. Wall/floor edge detected at y=971.

placements._note: The open brick left of the armchair, which begins around x=700.

scenes.name: Red brick living room
scenes._calibration: Brick coursing gives a 34.1 px period, 3.96 px/cm at an 86 mm course. Independently confirmed by the sofa measuring 206 cm wide, right for a three-seater. Wall/floor edge at y=1175; sofa back tops out around 60 cm.

placements._note: Centred on the sofa, hung 155 cm off the floor so the bottom edge clears the sofa back with a comfortable gap.

scenes.name: Panelled bedroom
scenes._calibration: No brick to measure here. Scale set from two agreeing estimates: a 180 cm headboard gives 2.44 px/cm and a 280 cm floor-to-ceiling gives 2.48, so 2.46. Wall/floor edge at y=1025; headboard tops out near 83 cm.

placements._note: Centred over the headboard at 165 cm, which keeps the work clear of the bed and narrower than it.
